title: Corpus integrity
description: The integrity blob of CorpusProcess.wit: the share of shards (CorpusOptions.SamplingRate) that ran twice in one Grid.ForEach call, their two executions compared on everything an honest node cannot vary (verdict, content hash, document counts, drop and language histograms). The platform keeps the two on different machines and the document does not say which. Empty pairs at rate 0.

sampled.description: Pairs of executions of one shard.

compared.description: Pairs whose two sides ran the same controller version.

version_skew.description: Pairs whose sides ran different controller versions - a rollout in progress (not compared).

mismatch_rate.description: mismatches / compared; 0 when nothing was compared.

pairs.description: One record per sampled shard, ordered by index.

differs.description: Present on a mismatch: the fields that differ.

controller.description: The controller version that ran this side.
